description: Round 16, Codex 9: `test.fail` on a test that times out: Playwright reports `timedOut`, outcome `unexpected`. The recorder keeps it a failure, never xfailed. The canonical FAIL stands under the contract; the test not ending before its timeout is outside the third assumption.

outsideAssumption.note: the test does not end before its timeout (assumption 3): Playwright reports timedOut, an unexpected failure, not an expected one
